title: Cohomological dimension of a separably closed point
statement: If $K$ is a separably closed field then $\kuncd(\Spec(K))=0$.

proof.text: The only prime ideal of the field $K$ is $(0)$, so $\Spec(K)$ has one underlying point; every open cover has a one-member subcover and every intersection of affine opens is either empty or the whole point. Thus it is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. By [def-kun-cd], for this scheme $\Spec(K)$ the assertion $\kuncd(\Spec(K))=0$ is equivalent to vanishing of $H^q(\Spec(K)_{\Et},F)$ for every torsion abelian étale sheaf $F$ and every $q>0$, since the defining nonnegative bound has least possible value 0. Applying [lem-kun-03qu-sep-closed] to each torsion abelian étale sheaf (which is in particular an abelian étale sheaf) gives exactly these vanishings, so the cohomological dimension is 0.
